description: This file contains media type conversion functions for Mojo IPC, converting media buffer and config objects to and from Mojo IPC representations.

methods.name: TypeConverter<media::mojom::DecryptConfigPtr, media::DecryptConfig>::Convert

methods.description: Converts a Mojo DecryptConfigPtr to a unique_ptr of media::DecryptConfig.

methods.description: Converts a Mojo DecoderBufferPtr to a scoped_refptr of media::DecoderBuffer.
